title: Swahili Groundnut Stew
community: Swahili coast — the richest vegetarian coastal stew
author: Mama Salima
desc: Swahili Groundnut Stew — a rich peanut sauce stew with Zanzibar spices, coconut milk, and mixed vegetables. The coastal fusion of the inland peanut tradition with coastal coconut — richer and more aromatic than either alone.
longDesc: Swahili groundnut stew is the coastal meeting point of two great Tanzanian flavour traditions — the inland peanut stew and the coastal coconut curry. Combined with the Zanzibar spice palette, it produces a vegetarian stew of extraordinary richness.
steps: Heat oil. Cook onions until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and spices. Add tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes.
Add sweet potato and water. Simmer 12 minutes.
Add green beans. Simmer 6 more minutes.
Mix peanut butter with ½ cup warm water. Add to pot.
Add coconut milk. Simmer gently 8 minutes.
chefTips: Mix peanut paste with warm water first.
Add coconut milk after peanuts — prevents curdling.
cookingScience: See TZA049 and TZA091 for peanut and coconut milk science.
sustainabilityTips: Peanuts, coconut, and vegetables all locally sourced.
culturalNote: Swahili groundnut stew is the taste of two traditions meeting — the inland peanut and the coastal coconut, unified by the Zanzibar spice palette into something that belongs entirely to the coast.
